## Background

The goal of this mini-projectis for you to explore a complete analysis using the machine learning techniques covered in class.

Today we will analyze a biopsy data-set from fine needle aspiration (FNA) of breast mass.


## Data Import

The data is made available as a CSV filr for download. We can read this with the `read.csv()` function
